cues.en: See if we just have the wrong topology and parameters for our RBM.
cues.zh: 看看是否只是 RBM 的拓樸與參數不對。

cues.en: The right number of hidden nodes, the right learning rate, the right bat size and the right number of epochs needed to converge, all depend on the amount and the nature of our training data.
cues.zh: 適當隱藏節點數、學習率、批次大小，以及收斂所需訓練週期，都取決於訓練資料的量與性質。

cues.en: So there is no single correct answers for RBM's in general.
cues.zh: 因此，RBM 沒有通用的唯一正確答案。

cues.en: It's your job to tune the RBM for the data that we have.
cues.zh: 你的工作，是針對手上資料調整 RBM。

cues.en: As we did before, use Surprise Libs Grid Search CV class and pick a couple of hyper parameters to work with.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，用 SurpriseLib 的 GridSearchCV，選幾個超參數。

cues.en: Keep trying different sets of values, using the results each time to converge on a better set of values to try next time, until you have parameters that yield the best results.
cues.zh: 不斷嘗試不同值組合，利用每次結果，收斂到下一次更好的候選值，直到找到結果最佳的參數。

cues.en: I'd encourage you to write this from scratch, if you're up for it but you may have noticed that my solution is already in your course materials as the RBM Tuning.py file.
cues.zh: 如果願意，鼓勵從零寫，但你可能發現，我的解答已在教材 RBMTuning.py。

cues.en: If you choose to cheat and just use my code, it's still a worthwhile exercise as most of the work here is just the process of converging on the right values, by trying different stuff out.
cues.zh: 如果選擇偷懶、直接用我的程式碼，仍值得做，因為主要工作，是嘗試不同設定，逐漸找出正確值。

cues.en: In general, I advise starting with the default values for a given parameter and try doubling it, just to see if you should be increasing or decreasing it.
cues.zh: 一般建議，先從預設參數開始，加倍，看看應該增加還是減少。

cues.en: If doubling it helps your accuracy, try a point halfway between your original values that you tested to see if that works even better.
cues.zh: 如果加倍改善準確程度，就試原先測過兩值的中間點，看看是否更好。

cues.en: Or if doubling hurt accuracy, try halving the value instead.
cues.zh: 如果加倍變差，改試減半。

cues.en: It's a bit of a slog, but it's something you'll have to do in the real world.
cues.zh: 有點辛苦，但真實世界必須做。

cues.en: And it's as important as anything in getting the best results from your work.
cues.zh: 而且，與其他任何事情一樣，對取得最佳結果都很重要。

cues.en: Pace yourself though, running cross validation on multiple permutations, training in RBM every time, takes a lot of time.
cues.zh: 但別太急，多個參數排列做交叉驗證，每次都訓練 RBM，非常耗時。

cues.en: Be prepared to just run it in the background, do something else for awhile, tweak things and run it again.
cues.zh: 準備好背景執行，去做別的事，過一陣子調整，再跑。

cues.en: It can take hours of wall talk time, but the time it actually requires your attention isn't so bad.
cues.zh: 實際經過時間可能好幾小時，但真正需要你關注的時間，還不算太多。

cues.en: In the next video, we'll review my results so don't continue until you've had a chance to try it yourself.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，會看我的結果，所以先自己試過，再繼續。
